title: Complete weighted-elimination and degree proof of (7/3)n-4 for MOD-3

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"For every integer n>=0, f_n(x)=1 iff the Hamming weight of x is congruent to 0 modulo 3; f_0(empty)=1. This single total language has the fixed residue-scan polynomial-time evaluator and empty-witness NP verifier proved in proof.md.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"3","numerator":"7"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"3","numerator":"7"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"In the full Li-Yang B2 model at actual input length n, C_B2(f_n)>=(7/3)*n-4 for every integer n>=2. Hence liminf over all integer lengths n of C_B2(f_n)/((7/3)*n)>=1. The finite coefficient/exponent projection is (7/3,1) for this same fixed family.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
